author: KhaledM_UAE
title: Axi froze my account without explanation — $12,000 locked
raw_text: My Axi account AXI-748291 was frozen on April 27 without any communication. I have emailed k.mansouri@gmail.com and called support 6 times. No one can tell me why my $12,000 is locked. I am contacting the DFSA if this is not resolved by end of week. This is completely unacceptable from a regulated broker.
